topic_en: Find eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the matrix A with rows three one and zero two. First, set up the characteristic equation determinant of A minus lambda I equals zero. Second, expand to get three minus lambda times two minus lambda equals zero. Third, solve to get lambda one equals three and lambda two equals two. Fourth, for lambda equals three, solve A minus three I times v equals zero to get the eigenvector one zero. Fifth, for lambda equals two, solve to get the eigenvector one minus one. Sixth, draw the two eigenvectors on a 2D coordinate plane with arrows. Seventh, animate how the matrix transforms a unit grid, showing that the eigenvectors only stretch by their eigenvalues and do not rotate.
topic_zh: 求 2x2 矩陣 [[3,1],[0,2]] 的特徵值與特徵向量，並視覺化變換

from manim import *


class MainScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # ===== Title =====
        title = Text("Eigenvalues & Eigenvectors", font_size=44, color=YELLOW)
        subtitle = MathTex(r"A = \begin{pmatrix} 3 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 \end{pmatrix}", font_size=40)
        subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.4)
        self.play(Write(title))
        self.play(FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP))
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(
            title.animate.scale(0.6).to_edge(UP),
            FadeOut(subtitle),
        )
        self.wait(0.5)

        # ===== Step 1: Characteristic equation =====
        step1 = Text("1. Characteristic equation", font_size=30, color=BLUE).to_edge(LEFT).shift(UP * 2)
